skins.name: Fluffy Little Witch
skins.description: Perhaps every girl has dreamed of it—raising a parasol, donning a top hat, letting her magic dance across the night sky. She tells her fluffy friends the moment for dreams to come true is here.

skins.name: The Train Runner
skins.description: As a child, dressed in pristine clothes, he too chased the shadows of trains out of curiosity. Now, stepping onto exotic platforms, his goals are far clearer.
skins.image: /six-star-skins/Executor the Ex Foedere - The Train Runner.webp

skins.name: Wanderer in the Rain
skins.code: Brand Collaborative Series/Wanderer in the Rain
skins.description: Raindrops slide down his clear umbrella to his feet, and the night wind lifts the hem of his white coat. Though the path ahead remains unclear, he knows where to go.
